paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Midiate tungah Israel suante phu la in: huai khit in na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding, chi in.
english: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in mipite a houpih a, Midiate tung a TOUPA phulakna tangtun ding a Midiate sual kidou ding in na lak ua mi kigalvan uhen.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

paite: Israel nam tengteng lak a nam chih a mi sangkhat zel kidouna a na hoh ding uh ahi, chi in.
english: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”

paite: Huchi in Israelte sang tamtak lak a kipan, nam chih a kipan in sangkhat chiat, kidouna a hoh ding in sepaih singkhat leh sang nih a pekhia uh.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in chichih lak a mi sangkhat chiat leh siampu Eleazar tapa Phineha mun siangthou a tui-um-belsuante, thupiakna ding khawng a pengkulte tawi in kidouna ah a hohsak a.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in Midiate a dou ua; pasal teng a that uh.
english: They warred against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses; and they killed every male.

paite: A mi thahte uh lak ah Midiate kumpipate leng a tel ua; Midiate kumpipa nga, Evite, Rekemte, Zurte, Hurte, Rebte: Beor tapa Balaam leng namsau in a that uh.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they killed with the sword.

paite: Huan, Israel suante'n Midiate naupang hon sal in a pi ua; huan, a gan tengteng uh, a belam hon tengteng uh, a van tengteng uh a gallak sum ding un a la uh.
english: The children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their livestock, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.

paite: A omna khua tengteng uh, a giahna mun tengteng uh a hal vek uh.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.

paite: Huan, mihing leh gan, sal leh gallak sum tengteng a paipih vek ua.
english: They took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of animal.

paite: Huan, salte, matte, gallak sumte Mosi leh siampu Eleazar leh Israel suante omkhawmte kiang ah, Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab phai a a giahna mun uh a hontun uhi.
english: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte inntek penpente'n khomual ah a na dawn ua.
english: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them outside of the camp.

paite: Huan, Mosi bel sepaih heutu, sang tung a heutute leh za tung a heutute, kidouna a kipan a hong tungah a heh a.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

paite: Mosi in a kiang uah, Numei tengteng na hinghawi vek uh maw?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

paite: Ngai un, Balaam lem theih in Peor tungtang thu ah Israelte TOUPA tung a tatlekna tungsak mite hiaite ahi uhi, TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah hii a hong leng a kei maw.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in naupangte lak a pasal tengteng that unla, numei mi kithuahpih sa tengteng leng that un.
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

paite: Numei naupang mi kithuahpih nailouh tengteng bel nou a ding in hawi un.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

paite: Huan, khomual ah ni sagih giak unla; kuapeuh mi that leh misi koih ni thum ni leh ni sagih ni in kisiangsak un, noumau leh na salte uleng.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days: whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

paite: Huan, van himhim leh savun a thilbawl tengteng kelmul a thilbawl tengteng, sing a thilbawl tengteng thu ah na kisiangsak ding uh ahi, a chi a.
english: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”

paite: Huan, siampu Eleazar in kidouna a hoh kidou mite kiang ah, Hiai TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak dan thuseh ahi:
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:

paite: Bangpeuh hi hen, dangka-engte, dangkasikte, dalte, sikte, langvate, ngente,
english: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

paite: Bangpeuh mei a hal a se theilou peuhmahte mei ah na tholh paisuak ding ua, huchi in a hong siangthou ding: bangpeuh hi hen, silsiang na tui a hih siangthou ding ahi: huan, mei a hal thuak theilou peuhmah tui a na tholh paisuak ding uh ahi.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

paite: Huan, a ni sagih ni in na puan uh na sawp ding ua, huan, na hong siangthou ding uh, huai khit in giahna mun ah na hong lut ding uh ahi, a chi a.
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean; and afterward you shall come into the camp.”

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Nang toh, siampu Eleazar toh, omkhawmte innkuan inntek pente toh gallak sum dia a lak uh mihing leh gante sim vek unla:
english: “Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

paite: Huan, gallak sum mun nih ah khen unla, kidouna a hoh kidoumite ding leh omkhawmte ding in:
english: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

paite: Huan, kidouna a hoh galkap mi a kipan in TOUPA ding a siah piak ding sepkhe zel unla, thil hing zanga zel ah khat, mihing a kipan bang, bawng a kipan bang, sabengtung a kipan bang, belam hon a kipan bang in:
english: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

paite: Huaite a tan kimkhat ua kipan la unla, TOUPA a di'n vei thillat ding in siampu Eleazar pia un.
english: Take it of their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

paite: 30 Huan, a kimkhat Israel suante tuam pen sawmnga a kipan khat sepkhe zel inla, mihing a kipan bang, bawng a kipan bang, sabengtung a kipan bang, belam hon a kipan bang, gan hon a kipan bang in; huan, huaite TOUPA biakbuk kem mi Levite pia in, a chi a.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the tabernacle of Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in a hih uh.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Sepaihte'n a mat uh gallak sum sim lou a a lak uh belam nuaiguk leh singsagih leh sangnga,
english: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

paite: Bawng sing sagih leh sangnga,
english: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

paite: Sabengtung singguk leh sangkhat,
english: and sixty-one thousand donkeys,

paite: Mihing bel numei, pasal kithuahpih nailouh sing thum leh sang nih ahi uh.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

paite: Huan, a kimkhat, kidouna a hohte tantuan pen, belam nuai thum leh singthum leh sang sagih leh sang sagih leh za nga ahi:
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:

paite: Huan, TOUPA siah belam pen zaguk leh sawm sagih leh nga.
english: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

paite: Huan, bawng singthum leh sangguk ahi a; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk leh khat ahi.
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

paite: Huan, sabengtung sing thum leh zanga ahi; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk leh khat ahi.
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

paite: Huan, mihing singkhat leh sangguk ahi ua; huai a TOUPA siah mi sawmthum leh nih ahi uh.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in siah, TOUPA vei thillat Mosi in siampu Eleazar a pia a.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan, Mosi in galkapmite a kipan a a hawm Israel mite tantuan kimkhat,
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who warred

paite: (Mipi tantuan kimkhat belam nuai thum leh singthum leh sangsagih leh zanga,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

paite: Bawng singthum leh sangguk
english: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

paite: Sabengtung singthum leh zanga,
english: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

paite: Mihing singkhat leh sangguk; )
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

paite: Israel tantuan kimkhat a kipan Mosi in mihing leh gan sawmnga zel ah khat a la a, TOUPA thupiak bang in TOUPA biakbuk kem mi Levite a pia a.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the tabernacle of Yahweh; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan, sepaihte tung a heutu, sang tung a heutute, za tung a heutute'n Mosi a va naih ua;
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses;

paite: Mosi kiang ah, Na sikhate'n ka khut ua om kidou mite ka sim ua, kuamah kimlou ka om kei uh.
english: and they said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

paite: Huan, ka hinna ua ding a TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlna ding in TOUPA ding a thillat mi'n a neihlam uh, dangka-eng a bawl zep hoih van, khe ngawng a bulhte, khut ngawng a bulhte, min sawnna zungbuhte, bilbahte, khite, ko'n tawi uhi, a chi ua.
english: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

paite: Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in dangka-eng a bawl van tengteng uh a na la ua.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

paite: Sang tung a heutute leh za tung a heutute dangka-eng TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia a lat tengteng uh sekel singkhat leh sangguk leh zasagih leh sawmnga ahi.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

paite: (Galkap mite a gallak sum uh amau achiat dia la ahi uh).Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sang tung a heutu leh za tung a heutute dangka-eng a la ua, Israel suante theih gigena ding in kihoupihna puan inn ah TOUPA ma ah a hon tawi uhi.
english: (The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)

paite: Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sang tung a heutu leh za tung a heutute dangka-eng a la ua, Israel suante theih gigena ding in kihoupihna puan inn ah TOUPA ma ah a hon tawi uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.
